description: A 12HP panel that steps through a numbered sequence of SVG files, one frame per clock pulse, with an end-of-cycle output

inputs.text: Each rising edge past 1V moves to the next frame, in whichever order the play mode sets
A rising edge past 1V returns the sequence to its first frame and points ping pong forward again; a reset and a clock arriving in the same sample are settled in the reset's favour

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse each time the sequence finishes a pass through the frames, or on every clock pulse while a single frame is loaded

notes: the panel is empty until you load a sequence: right-click it and choose Load Flipbook Image..., then pick any file of a numbered set such as cat_01.svg.
picking one file loads every SVG in the same folder whose name matches it apart from the number on the end, ordered by that number, to a limit of 128 frames.
a file whose name does not end in a number is loaded on its own, as a sequence of one frame.
with nothing patched into the clock input nothing advances and the panel holds the frame it is on.
a file that cannot be read is replaced by the plugin's own fallback picture, so a missing frame shows something rather than a gap.
the first time the plugin loads it makes a Sticksy folder in your Rack user folder and copies the bundled artwork there, including a sixteen-frame cat sequence.
the file browser opens in that Animation folder the first time you load a flipbook in a session.
in Random mode the end-of-cycle output fires once every time as many clock pulses have arrived as there are frames, rather than at any particular frame.
menu: Load Flipbook Image... — opens a file browser and loads the numbered sequence that the file you pick belongs to
Load Background Image... — loads one SVG that is drawn behind every frame
Clear Background — removes the background picture; it is greyed out while there is none
Play Mode: Forward, Reverse, Ping Pong, Random — sets the order the clock steps through the frames

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
